separation: Not one of the ten transport groups, not an actor delivery or six-case cohort result. No reader context or expected answers enter actual cohort.

readerInput.images: only ordered native PNGs; neutral opaque paths; no source/DOM/author summary
readerInput.prompt: Read all supplied images in order. State the first visible sentence, the last visible sentence, and the color of the square. Report any other visible code.

pivot: If native image input/tool receipt, full tile access or any answer is unavailable/incorrect, hold actual readers. No actor reads or fallback to text.

answerMatching.sentences: Exact words and order; case-insensitive; terminal punctuation optional.

actualImageEvidence.tools: Native image tool opens all three actual PNGs at native resolution; externally retain actual call/input records, not agent self-attestation.
actualImageEvidence.isolation: Fresh context, toy PNG paths and neutral question only; expected answers/HTML/DOM/transport case keys unavailable.
actualImageEvidence.hold: Unavailable image tooling or any missing image/call evidence holds actual readers; no text fallback.
